title: Decode String
summary: Expand an encoding where k[part] repeats the decoded part k times.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–30 characters of valid encoding. Counts are in [1,300]. Digits occur only as counts before opening brackets. Decoded output length is at most 100000.
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned str.

statement: Expand an encoding where k[part] repeats the decoded part k times. Bracketed parts may contain other repetitions. Ordinary lowercase letters appear unchanged. Return the fully expanded string.

examples.explanation: Each repeated outer block contains x and three ys.
Literal characters remain around the repeated part.
The count may contain multiple digits.

constraints: 1–30 characters of valid encoding. Counts are in [1,300]. Digits occur only as counts before opening brackets. Decoded output length is at most 100000.
hints: Conceptual: A closing bracket finishes the most recent unfinished repetition.
Directional: Save the outer text and count before entering a bracket.
Implementation: On a closing bracket, repeat the completed inner text by its saved count and append it to the saved outer text.
complexityAnalysis: O(n + dL) time and O(n + dL) peak auxiliary space for the internal expansion reference, where L is decoded length and d is nesting depth. A streaming implementation can improve copying costs.
